label: Write code and run
description: Write a text file into another project's code (keeping the file it replaces at another path), then start a run of that project's `out` on it. A project-local node the e2e rig uses to prove a program can edit, build and run another project of its owner.

inputs.name: project
inputs.description: The id of the project whose code is written and run.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: The project-relative path of the file to write.

inputs.name: keptAs
inputs.description: Where the file it replaces is kept, copied by its hash.

outputs.name: runId
outputs.description: The id of the run started on the written code.
